title: P15 B6 control: the old-bytes arm died on ImportError (exit 1) instead of demonstrating the {} == {} defect
what_went_wrong: The old p12_perencounter_reconcile.py ran from .bak_p15 (only the changed files), so its sys.path import of dbutil failed; exit 1 for the wrong reason; one log file was shared by all arms, hiding the traceback.
root_cause: The old-arm runner did not provide the shared modules and did not keep per-arm logs.
detection: P15 chain step 3e: 'B6 OLD bytes pass the uncovered encounter' got 1, want 0.
impact: No false claim; the control reported FAIL.

correction.applied: PYTHONPATH to the tools dir for every arm, one log per arm; re-frozen (manifest b) and re-run in p15_chain_e.sh.

rule: An old-bytes control must first prove the old bytes run (a clean arm on the old bytes) before its result means anything.
